title: Verify: App header round states unit tests
summary: Unit tests for loading, success and error header states in App with the API mocked.
description: Mock ../src/api/client getCurrentRound and assert header states after Begin.

steps.action: Create the file with // @vitest-environment jsdom; vi.mock('../src/api/client') and set getCurrentRound with mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => {})) for loading, mockResolvedValue(roundFixture) for success, mockRejectedValue(new Error('boom')) for error. Render App, click the Begin button, then assert: 'Loading round…' text; findByText(roundFixture.id) and status; findByRole('alert') has text containing 'boom'. The roundFixture comes from tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirrors the Round type in src/api/client.ts and the backend current-round handler response; do not inline the payload.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appHeader.test.tsx
